title: PowerShell attempts to weaken Microsoft Defender Antivirus
description: Detects literal PowerShell Defender cmdlets requesting selected disable switches with a true value or adding explicit non-empty exclusion values. Command-line evidence does not prove the configuration changed.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may use Defender PowerShell cmdlets to create a protection gap before executing later actions.
hypothesis.rationale: Microsoft warns that exclusions reduce protection and MITRE documents security-control tampering; legitimate management and troubleshooting scripts can use the same cmdlets.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Bind a selected disable parameter to its own true value or match an explicit non-empty exclusion literal. Variables, splatting, aliases and dynamically constructed commands are outside this bounded rule.

data_sources.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint process events

triage.summary: Resolve the requested Defender change, its initiating process and whether device-management policy authorized it.
steps: Review the full command, parent process, account, device, exclusion value and requested protection switch.
Compare the command with approved endpoint-management, software-deployment and troubleshooting activity.
Check Defender configuration and tamper-protection telemetry, then inspect subsequent payload execution or persistence if the change is unexplained.
This bounded command-line rule does not decode scripts or resolve variables, aliases, splatting, script contents or dynamic expressions.
false_positives: Approved endpoint-management scripts, software compatibility exclusions and temporary support diagnostics

validation.expected_outcome: Match selected Defender disable switches followed by $true or 1 and explicit non-empty exclusion literals. Reject false-valued disable switches, unrelated true values, null or empty exclusion resets.

limitations: Only explicit command-line disable literals are covered. Variables, aliases, splatting, alternative APIs and actual resulting protection state are not evaluated.
Current-revision evidence is synthetic only. Validate full generated KQL, source fields, ingestion delay, alert volume and scoped exclusions in the target before enabling.
